bounds_derived.B1_contour_cell_normal_speed: |v_n| at the contour support cell <= min(envelope, band cap if that cell lies in the chi >= 0.01 band); for any admissible state this is implied by the frozen gate set itself
bounds_derived.B1b_contour_point_normal_speed: the bilinear value at the contour crossing point is a convex combination of its four supporting cells, so |v_n(point)| <= sum_c w_c * cap_c with cap_c the per-cell cap; this is the tightest statement available without assuming the point lies in one regime
bounds_derived.B2_placeable_downward_momentum: P_down <= v_max * sum_{open, chi<0.01} V_i phi_i : pointwise speed cap times the admissible liquid volume, valid for any admissible field
bounds_derived.B3_in_band_phase_flux: downward advective phase flux over in-band faces <= v_band * sum_f A_f phi_upwind,f, because every in-band cell speed is <= v_band so every in-band face speed is too
bounds_derived.B4_in_band_transport_time: crossing an in-band normal distance ds takes at least ds / v_band while the initializer constraint set holds
bounds_derived.B5_shape_ratio_criterion: for a seed built as psi = sx * envelope * seam * T(sdf) and renormalised so the mandated phi>=0.9 core mean equals -u_impact, the ratio max_band|v| / |core mean v| is a shape invariant independent of the amplitude. A shape whose ratio exceeds the band gate can never be admissible under the mandated core target, whatever its amplitude; this is a necessary rejection that costs no construction

constructibility_rule: a necessary bound is not an attained one: attainment is claimed only when an explicit diagnostic construction satisfies the six frozen gates and the envelope at the mandated core target, and the construction is never promoted to a production initializer
envelope_definition: the maximum peak open-cell seed speed the frozen reference family (C0/C1/C2) itself produces in the same cases, sealed in L1A-2u and re-read through the L1A-2v seal; it is a reference-calibrated cap, not a physical threshold

region_definitions.wall_samples: wall_measure > 0, bilinear cell-velocity sample at wall centroid

infeasibility_rule: a failed search is reported as NOT_FOUND_NOT_PROVEN_INFEASIBLE; SHAPE_REJECTED_BY_THE_BAND_GATE_AT_THE_MANDATED_CORE_TARGET states only that a specific shape cannot satisfy the band gate at the mandated core target, not that no seed exists; PROVEN_INFEASIBLE_BY_BOUND may only be used when a derived bound rules an option out mathematically
prespecification_rule: case set, candidate set, gate values, envelope, band cap, the ramp ladder and the verdict vocabulary are fixed before any measurement

prohibitions.trajectories: none; the frozen substep kernel is never constructed

R0_WEAK.role: weak roll-off: minimum geometrically admissible clearance, widest transition

R1_MEDIUM.role: medium roll-off: mid-window clearance at the prespecified transition width

R2_SHARP.role: strong roll-off: mid-window clearance with the sharpest transition

separation_required.finite_time: what can reach the contour in finite time from the t=0 state. The six gates constrain the initializer, not the evolved solver, so B3/B4 describe the initial configuration's reachability only; they are not a bound on the subsequent trajectory, whose transport is governed by the frozen solver's advection, Brinkman penalization and Cahn-Hilliard dynamics
separation_required.instantaneous: what the t=0 state does at the frozen phi=0.5 contour right now: the normal speed at the contour support cell and at the contour crossing point, plus the frozen face flux there
